purpose: Immutable value events, reconciliation, baseline provenance, CFO drill-down, and audit-pack exports.
invariants: value events are workspace-scoped and protected by PostgreSQL RLS
value events are append-only at the database trigger boundary
event keys are workspace-scoped and idempotent
every event carries a method, confidence, and formula version
signed baseline and immutable workflow hashes are retained on execution events
auto plus reviewed plus halted equals ingested with no orphan source records
dashboard totals and drill-down rows are calculated from the same event rows
CSV and PDF exports carry reconciliation and provenance evidence
safe replay does not create value events or side effects
